defs.def: to behave in a particular way, in order to make other people believe sth that is not true 假装；佯装

ex.s: She decided that she would memorize where her classes were and then pretend that the rest of the place didn’t exist.
ex.t: 她决定记住教室的位置，然后假装其他地方都不存在。

ex.s: They pretended to walk slowly away from the dog.
ex.t: 他们假装慢慢地从狗身边走开。

ex.s: I always wanted to know what my mom was reading． Hearing mom say，"I can't believe what's printed in the newspaper this morning，" made me want to grab it out of her hands and read it myself． I wanted to be like my mom and know all of the things she knew． So I carried around a book， and each night， just to be like her， I would pretend to be reading．
ex.t: 我一直想知道妈妈在读什么。听到妈妈说“真不敢相信今天早上报纸上印了什么”，我就想从她手里抢过报纸自己读。我想成为像妈妈那样的人，知道她知道的所有事情。于是我随身带着一本书，每天晚上，就为了像她一样，我还会假装在阅读。

ex.s: People who pretend to be someone they are not tend to misjudge themselves.
ex.t: 那些假装成别人的人往往会错误地判断自己。

ex.s: Yes, and how many times can a man turn his head Pretending he jus(t) doesn’(t) see?
ex.t: 是啊，一个人能转过头去假装自己没看见多少次呢？

ex.s: To hide the 7 awful truth from his son, Guido pretends they are LF at a holiday camp and are playing a game.
ex.t: 为了对儿子隐瞒______的可怕真相，圭多假装他们在一个度假营地里玩游戏。

ex.s: Miss Chevalier pretended not to have noticed my red face and handed me a dictionary, asking me to read its definition aloud.
ex.t: 谢瓦利埃小姐假装没注意到我涨红的脸，递给我一本字典，让我大声读出其中的释义。

defs.def: to imagine that sth is true as part of a game 尤指儿童
to claim to be, do or have sth, especially when this is not true 通常用于否定句和疑问句
